question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1** i.e.** Individual'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence is discussing** the entities that can move the Supreme Court by filing a Writ Petition.
 
• **In legal contexts,** courts are often approached by persons or entities seeking justice or resolution.
 
• The term **"Individual" **(व्यक्ति) aptly refers to a single person or entity, fitting well in the context that even a single person can approach the court.
 
• The **succeeding part of the sentence also refers **to "group of persons", which complements the word "individual", indicating that both single persons and groups can approach the court.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Fauna" **(जंगली जीवन) refers to the animal life of a particular region or period, and is not relevant to the context of who can approach the Supreme Court.
 
• **"Personnel"** (कर्मचारी) typically refers to employees or staff of an organization. In the given context, it doesn't specifically convey the idea of a single person or entity approaching the court.
 
• **"Species"** (प्रजातियाँ) refers to a group of living organisms consisting of similar individuals. It doesn't fit in the context of entities moving the court.
